summary.vi: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, COUNT(DISTINCT)
summary.en: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, COUNT(DISTINCT)

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
SELECT
  COUNT(*)      AS num_products,
  MIN(price)    AS cheapest,
  MAX(price)    AS priciest,
  AVG(price)    AS avg_price,
  SUM(stock)    AS total_stock
FROM products;

prompt.vi: Tính tổng giá trị tồn kho: SUM(price * stock) của bảng products.
prompt.en: Compute the total inventory value: SUM(price * stock) over the products table.

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT name, price, stock FROM products;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code: SELECT SUM(price * stock) AS inventory_value FROM products;

label.en: Equals the exact sum of price*stock
